Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer)
	postcondition:
		card.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		InputCard = card and
		CardIDValidated = true and
		result = CardIDValidated or
		card.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		CardIDValidated = false and
		result = CardIDValidated
}
